primary.$description: Primary brand color. Aliases to specific branded property tokens (color.icon.brand, color.fill.interactive.brand, color.text.brand, color.border.brand, etc.). Always defer to specific branded property tokens over this parent token.

secondary.$description: Secondary brand color. Aliases to specific branded property tokens (icon, fill, text, border, etc.). Always defer to specific branded property tokens over this parent token.

primary.$description: Primary interactive color. Aliases to specific interactive property tokens (icon, fill, text, border, etc.). Always defer to specific branded interactive tokens over this parent token.

secondary.$description: Secondary interactive color. Aliases to specific interactive property tokens (icon, fill, text, border, etc.). Always defer to specific branded interactive tokens over this parent token.

success.$description: Primary success status color. Aliases to specific success status property tokens (icon, fill, text, border, etc.). Always defer to specific success status property tokens over this parent token.

info.$description: Primary info status color. Aliases to specific info status property tokens (icon, fill, text, border, etc.). Always defer to specific info status property tokens over this parent token.

warning.$description: Primary warning status color. Aliases to specific warning status property tokens (icon, fill, text, border, etc.). Always defer to specific warning status property tokens over this parent token.

caution.$description: Primary caution status color. Aliases to specific caution status property tokens (icon, fill, text, border, etc.). Always defer to specific caution status property tokens over this parent token.

danger.$description: Primary danger status color. Aliases to specific danger status property tokens (icon, fill, text, border, etc.). Always defer to specific danger status property tokens over this parent token.

primary.$description: Use as the primary background for your UI shell.

secondary.$description: Use as the secondary background for your UI shell (e.g. left sidebar).

primary.$description: Use as the primary background color for UI surfaces (e.g., cards, page sections, content areas).

secondary.$description: Use as the secondary background color for UI surfaces (e.g., cards, page sections).

floating.$description: Use as the background color for floating UI surfaces (e.g., toast alerts, menus, modals, overlay drawers).

glass.$description: Use as the background color for glass UI surfaces.

disabled.$description: Use as the fill color for disabled elements.

default.$description: Use as the default fill color for primary interactive elements (e.g., primary buttons).

hover.$description: Use as the hover state fill color for primary interactive elements.

pressed.$description: Use as the pressed state fill color for primary interactive elements. Not intended for selected states.

selected.$description: Use as the selected state fill color for primary interactive elements.

default.$description: Use as the default fill color for control elements (e.g., form inputs, menu toggles).

read-only.$description: Use as the read-only fill color for control elements (e.g., form inputs, menu toggles).

default.$description: Use as the default fill color for branded interactive elements (e.g., primary CTA backgrounds).

hover.$description: Use as the hover state fill color for branded interactive elements.

pressed.$description: Use as the pressed state fill color for branded interactive elements. Not intended for selected states.

selected.$description: Use as the selected state fill color for branded interactive elements (e.g., navigation items, selected/active tabs, jump links).

default.$description: Use as the default fill color (transparent) for interactive elements that only require a fill on hover, focus, or pressed states (e.g., link buttons).

hover.$description: Use as the hover state fill color for interactive elements that use a transparent default fill.

pressed.$description: Use as the pressed state fill color for interactive elements that use a transparent default fill.

selected.$description: Use as the selected state fill color for interactive elements that use a transparent default fill.

default.$description: Use as the default background/fill color for elements conveying a danger status.
Use as the default background/fill color for elements conveying a warning status.
Use as the default background/fill color for elements conveying a success status.
Use as the default background/fill color for elements conveying an info status.

primary.$description: Use as the default color for icons and/or when paired with color.text.primary

secondary.$description: Use as the color for icons when you want the icon to have less emphasis and/or when paired with text.color.secondary

inverse.$description: Use for icons on inverse surfaces.

on-brand.$description: Use as the default color for icons that are placed on a brand background color and/or are paired with color.text.on-brand.

on-interactive.$description: Use for icons on elements with a primary interactive fill, like in a primary button.

disabled.$description: Use for disabled icons that are not on disabled surfaces.

on-disabled.$description: Use for icons placed on color.fill.disabled backgrounds.
